config.label: Your Massed Compute API key (Bearer token)
config.description: Your Massed Compute API key (Bearer token). Generate at https://vm.massedcompute.com/settings/api. Optional — `massed-compute-mcp init` provides an interactive first-run flow that prompts for the key, validates it, and stores it locally with 0600 permissions.

config.label: Your Massed Compute API key as a Bearer token (include the 'Bearer ' prefix)
config.description: Your Massed Compute API key as a Bearer token (include the 'Bearer ' prefix). Generate one at https://vm.massedcompute.com/settings/api — use a read-only key for analysis-only assistants so destructive tool calls (launch, restart, terminate, SSH-key deletion) are rejected at call time.
